# The shared fixture of tests/test_tracker_parity.py (ForgePact #185).
#
# tests/tracker_mod_parity_harness.cpp plays this script through the real
# TrackerMod core and its Win32 writer into a session file; the test then
# reads that file through the panel's tracker service and compares what the
# ledger reports with the harness's own counters. One operation per line:
#
#   identity <pid> <build id>         SetIdentity, and the session file's name
#   on                                SetEnabled(true)
#   frame <unix ms>                   BeginFrame (opens the file on the first)
#   end                               EndFrame, an append when it has lines,
#                                     then AgeCreationWindow
#   frames <n> <first ms> <step ms>   n times: frame, end
#   status                            RecordBridgeStatus(ready, the route summary)
#   room <name>                       NoteRoom
#   progress <name...>                RecordProgress
#   zone <act room> <buffs> <debuffs> <here 0|1>
#                                     RecordSatanicZone(SatanicZoneCode(room)),
#                                     ids comma-separated, `-` for none
#   zoneread <act room> <buffs> <debuffs>
#                                     ZoneAnswered: a polled zone read that
#                                     answered; the core decides whether to write
#   zonemiss <reason token>           ZoneUnanswered: a polled read that did not
#   gold|xp|kill <argc> <value...>    CountGold/CountXp/CountKill of what
#                                     CaptureGold/CaptureXp/CaptureKill decode;
#                                     a value is r<real>, i<int32>, l<int64> or x
#                                     (unsupported)
#   xpfalse <argc> <value...>         CountXp answered by an explicit false
#   create <key>                      NoteCreated(struct key)
#   drop <key> <rarity> <type> <id> <weapon type> <stamp> <name...>
#                                     DecideDrop: the guard asks RecentlyCreated
#                                     of <key>, the identity is item:<type>:<stamp>
#   drain                             Drain, appended (`tracker 0`)
#
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.

identity 4242 forgepact-parity
on
frame 1700000000000
status
room Town_01
progress Sorak
end
frames 29 1700000000016 16

# Into an act zone: a room change, its Satanic zone, then the fight.
frame 1700000001000
room Act_01_02
zone Act_01_03 6,14 3 0
kill 1 r12
kill 1 r12
kill 1 i7
kill 2 r1 r2
kill 1 r-1
gold 2 r0 r150
gold 1 l75
gold 4 r1 r2 r3 x
gold 1 r0.5
xp 2 r300 r1
xp 2 i45 r0
xpfalse 2 r50 r1
xp 1 r999
end

# One frame of drops: a create in this frame, one in the frame before.
frame 1700000001016
create 11
create 12
create 13
create 14
create 15
create 16
end
frame 1700000001032
create 17
create 18
drop 11 4 2 101 0 s11 Parity Set Ring
drop 12 6 0 102 3 s12 Parity Satanic Blade
drop 13 7 1 103 0 s13 Parity Angelic Helm
drop 14 9 0 104 5 s14 Parity Heroic Axe
drop 15 10 3 105 0 s15 Parity Unholy Chest
drop 16 5 0 106 0 s16 Parity Mythic Sword
drop 17 1 0 107 0 s17 Parity Common Dagger
drop 18 9 0 104 5 s14 Parity Heroic Axe
drop 99 9 0 108 0 s99 Parity Bag Drop
end
frames 27 1700000001048 16

# A second zone, more of the same, and a heartbeat's worth of frames.
frame 1700000012000
room Act_01_03
zone Act_01_03 6,14 3 1
kill 1 r12
gold 2 r0 r40
xp 2 r60 r1
end
frames 29 1700000012016 16
# A minute on, back in town: long enough for the run to be filed. The room
# change owes a zone record; the first read finds no player, a later one
# answers (written, since it was owed), a repeat writes nothing, and a
# rotation with no room change is written.
frame 1700000075000
room Town_01
zonemiss no-player
kill 1 r12
end
frame 1700000075250
zoneread Act_01_03 6,14 3
end
frame 1700000075500
zoneread Act_01_03 6,14 3
end
frame 1700000076000
zoneread Act_02_04 2,5 7,9
end
drain
